creators.name: Thomas Van Bouwel
creators.role: Solo indie developer (Cubism, Laser Dance); former architect
creators.bio: Belgian architect-turned-solo game developer behind the hand-tracked puzzle game Cubism and the mixed-reality game Laser Dance.
creators.why: Laser Dance turns any living room's own geometry into a procedurally fitted laser obstacle course, one of the purest uses of Quest scene understanding.

creators.name: Lucas Rizzotto
creators.role: Inventor, XR designer and YouTuber (Lucas Builds The Future)
creators.bio: Award-winning XR creator whose early HoloLens apps (CyberSnake, MyLab) and later YouTube inventions turned mixed reality into viral, story-driven experiments.
creators.why: He treats mixed reality as a medium for playful, emotional inventions, from a holographic snake that eats your room to turning a person into a theremin.

creators.name: Greg Madison
creators.role: XR interaction designer; former UX/interaction designer at Unity Labs
creators.bio: Interaction designer and futurist who spent years at Unity Labs prototyping how real objects, surfaces and bodies can become interfaces in mixed reality.
creators.why: His 'Tangible Mixed Reality' series and surface-based hand-tracking prototypes are some of the clearest demonstrations of blending physical objects with virtual UI.

creators.name: Leap Motion Design Research (Barrett Fox, Martin Schubert, Keiichi Matsuda et al.)
creators.role: Hand-tracking interaction design team at Leap Motion / Ultraleap
creators.bio: Leap Motion's small design research group published a stream of hand-interaction experiments and built Project North Star, an open-source wide-field AR headset.
creators.why: They defined much of the bare-hand vocabulary of headset AR (palm menus, wearable UI, desk interfaces) and open-sourced the hardware to explore it.

creators.name: Greg Broadmore (Weta Workshop / Weta Gameshop)
creators.role: Concept artist; creator of Dr. Grordbort; studio director of Weta Gameshop
creators.bio: Weta Workshop concept artist who created the retro-sci-fi Dr. Grordbort universe and led Weta Gameshop's multi-year collaboration with Magic Leap.
creators.why: His robot-invasion demos were the first widely seen vision of headset AR where characters burst out of your real walls.

creators.name: Asobo Studio
creators.role: Game developer; HoloLens launch-title studio (later HoloForge Interactive)
creators.bio: Bordeaux game studio that built the most ambitious HoloLens launch titles and later spun out HoloForge Interactive for holographic work.
creators.why: Fragments and Young Conker were the first games to rebuild their levels around the player's real room, placing characters on real sofas and walls.

creators.name: Sigur Rós
creators.role: Icelandic post-rock band; co-creators of the Magic Leap soundscape Tónandi
creators.bio: Icelandic band that spent five years with Magic Leap Studios building Tónandi, an interactive audio-visual soundscape.
creators.why: Tónandi recast music as something you touch in space: sounds grow as creatures around your room when you reach for them.

creators.name: Ryan McLeod
creators.role: Indie designer-developer of Blackbox (Apple Design Award winner)
creators.bio: Solo designer of Blackbox, a puzzle game with no buttons that uses the device's own sensors, twice an Apple Design Award winner, later rebuilt for Apple Vision Pro.
creators.why: He turns a device's sensors into the puzzle itself; on Vision Pro, puzzles respond to your gaze, hands, voice and the space around you.

creators.name: realities.io
creators.bio: Small studio that builds 3D jigsaw puzzles from photogrammetry scans of real places, with mixed-reality, hand-tracking and Vision Pro versions.
creators.why: Puzzling Places lets you rebuild miniature real-world landmarks piece by piece on your own table, alone or with a friend in the same room.

creators.name: Resolution Games
creators.role: XR game studio (Angry Birds FPS, Demeo, Spatial Ops)
creators.bio: Stockholm studio founded by Tommy Palm that has shipped mixed-reality games on Magic Leap, Quest and Vision Pro since 2018.
creators.why: Spatial Ops turned any home or office into a co-located first-person shooter arena, one of the first large-scale multiplayer MR games.

creators.name: Botao 'Amber' Hu
creators.role: Designer-researcher; founder of Reality Design Lab; inventor of HoloKit
creators.bio: Creative technologist and experiential futures designer who invented HoloKit, an open-source stereo iPhone AR headset, and leads Reality Design Lab's research on embodied, social mixed reality.
creators.why: His work pushes co-located MR toward street play, handshakes and non-human senses (bat echolocation, felt navigation) on cheap, open hardware.

creators.name: Daniel Beauchamp (Pushmatrix)
creators.role: Spatial-computing experimentalist; Head of AR/VR at Shopify
creators.bio: Principal AR/VR engineer at Shopify who posts short, often viral hand-tracking and mixed-reality experiments under the name Pushmatrix.
creators.why: He finds the tiny everyday use case, such as vacuuming coverage or live 3D previews, that makes headset MR feel inevitable.

creators.name: Max Weisel
creators.bio: Designer-engineer who co-founded Normal, maker of the Normcore multiplayer framework and the VR sport Nock, and prototypes cross-device AR/VR interaction.
creators.why: His prototypes let phone-AR users and headset users share one space, an early template for cross-reality multiplayer.

creators.name: Julian Triveri (anaglyph)
creators.role: Solo developer of Lasertag for Quest
creators.bio: Independent developer who builds Lasertag, a co-located mixed-reality laser tag game for Quest 3 that uses real-time depth to map rooms.
creators.why: Lasertag uses the Quest depth sensor and synced room scanning so laser beams and hits respect every real obstacle, shared across all players.

creators.name: Stijn Spanhove
creators.role: XR developer at In The Pocket; Snap Spectacles creator
creators.bio: Belgian XR developer who builds rapid AR-glasses proofs of concept for Snap Spectacles and Meta AI glasses, often pairing them with generative AI.
creators.why: He prototypes what AR glasses plus AI can do in daily life, from a real-world ad blocker to drawings that become playable worlds.

creators.name: Pavlo Tkachenko
creators.role: AR developer and Snap Spectacles lens creator
creators.bio: AR developer who builds Spectacles lenses, often with Stijn Spanhove, and won a Spectacles Community Challenge with his generative lens Bubbles.
creators.why: His lenses make AR glasses feel playful and physical: generating objects from a prompt, or flying a plane with head movement.

creators.name: Creature
creators.bio: Small independent studio behind Starship Home, a narrative mixed-reality game for Quest 3.
creators.why: Starship Home rebuilds your real room as a spaceship interior, replacing windows and walls with space views while you care for alien plants.

works.title: Laser Dance
works.description: A Quest 3 mixed-reality game that scans your living room and strings laser beams between your real walls and furniture; you dance, dodge and crawl through the beams to reach buttons.
works.idea_zh: 把自家客厅的真实墙面和家具变成激光迷阵，用全身躲避穿越。

works.title: Cubism (Mixed Reality mode)
works.description: The hand-tracked block puzzle Cubism rebuilt for passthrough: colored polycube pieces float above your real table and you assemble them with your bare hands.
works.idea_zh: 用裸手在真实桌面上方拼装悬浮的彩色方块谜题。

works.title: CyberSnake
works.description: The classic Snake game rebuilt as a room-scale HoloLens hologram: you steer the snake with your head, chase holographic burgers located by spatial sound, and avoid your own tail around the room.
works.idea_zh: 把贪吃蛇变成满屋子游走的全息体，用头部方向和空间声音来玩。

works.title: MyLab
works.description: A holographic chemistry app for HoloLens with an interactive periodic table; you pull elements out into the room and inspect their atomic structure as 3D holograms.
works.idea_zh: 把元素周期表变成可以拿出来、放大观察的全息原子模型。

works.title: Working Marauder's Map
works.description: A physical parchment map of a rented 'mini Hogwarts' castle that, seen through a phone, shows everyone's GPS-tracked position as walking footprints with name labels, like the Marauder's Map.
works.idea_zh: 把《哈利波特》活点地图做成真的：纸质地图上用AR显示每个人实时移动的脚印。

works.title: Portal to My Best Friend
works.description: A quarantine project that opens a mixed-reality portal in his apartment wall onto his best friend's home, so the two can see and talk to each other as if the wall were gone.
works.idea_zh: 在墙上开一扇混合现实传送门，直通隔离中的好友家。

works.title: Pillow
works.description: A mixed-reality app for Quest designed to be used lying in bed: relaxing activities, stories and games float above you, and a friend can join from their own bed.
works.idea_zh: 专为躺在床上设计的混合现实应用，朋友也能从自己床上加入。

works.title: Human Theremin (AR synthesizer)
works.description: A HoloLens 2 app that tracks another person's body and turns it into a playable instrument: touching and moving around them triggers synth sounds and visuals, like an augmented theremin.
works.idea_zh: 把另一个人的身体变成可以演奏的AR合成器乐器。

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 01: Oculus Touch & haptics
works.description: First of a series in which Oculus Touch controllers track real objects so they can be mirrored inside VR; here real surfaces give passive haptic feedback to a virtual interface.
works.idea_zh: 用真实物体给虚拟界面提供被动触觉反馈。

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 02: Oculus Touch & launchpad
works.description: A physical launchpad controller is tracked and mirrored in VR so its real pads can be pressed while wearing a headset, with virtual feedback attached.
works.idea_zh: 把真实MIDI打击垫变成混合现实中的空间视觉控制器。

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 03: Oculus Touch & synthesizer
works.description: A real hardware synthesizer is registered in the virtual scene so you can play and tweak it while immersed, with virtual visuals attached to the instrument.
works.idea_zh: 转动真实合成器的旋钮，在空间中塑造声音可视化。

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 04: Oculus Touch & keyboard
works.description: A physical computer keyboard is tracked so you can type for real inside VR, with virtual labels and panels attached to the real keys.
works.idea_zh: 在VR中用真实键盘打字，并给实体按键叠加虚拟标签。

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 05: Oculus Touch & board game
works.description: A real board game is tracked and augmented with a virtual layer, pitching mixed reality as a way to 'uberize' ordinary physical objects the way MP3 did music.
works.idea_zh: 给真实桌游叠加虚拟棋子和动画，让普通物件被数字层重新定义。

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 06: Oculus Touch & ROBOT
works.description: A small physical robot is tracked with an Oculus Touch controller and mirrored in the virtual scene, blending a real moving machine with a virtual character.
works.idea_zh: 给真实的小机器人套上虚拟外形和界面，实体与虚拟角色合一。

works.title: Concept: AR cereal box
works.description: A 2017 Unity Labs concept from the 'future of mixed reality' series in which a cereal box becomes an interactive AR object with content attached to the packaging.
works.idea_zh: 把早餐麦片盒变成跳出内容的AR互动界面。

works.title: Tangible UI: hand tracking on flat surfaces
works.description: Using early Quest hand tracking, any real table becomes a giant touch screen: virtual buttons and sliders are laid flat on the desk and pressed with your fingers.
works.idea_zh: 用手部追踪把任意真实桌面变成巨大的触摸屏。

works.title: Audio Augmented Reality with face-tracking
works.description: An audio-first AR prototype that uses face tracking to follow your head and render spatial sound anchored in the room around you.
works.idea_zh: 用人脸追踪获取头部朝向，做只靠声音的空间AR。

works.title: Unity Slices: Table
works.description: A Unity Labs demo on Quest 2 passthrough that slides a real table along the reality spectrum, from pure passthrough to fully virtual, while you play chess and other tabletop games on it.
works.idea_zh: 在同一张真实桌子上连续滑动于现实与虚拟之间玩桌游。

works.title: Playing with realities in ShapeXR
works.description: Digital-twin experiments in ShapeXR where a virtual copy of his room lines up with the real one, letting him fade between passthrough and virtual versions of the same space.
works.idea_zh: 让房间的数字孪生与真实房间重合，在两者之间自由切换。

works.title: Augmented Keyboard
works.description: A tracked physical keyboard on Quest 2 gets one smart virtual screen and context-aware overlays instead of a wall of virtual monitors.
works.idea_zh: 给实体键盘配一块智能虚拟屏幕，而不是一堆虚拟显示器。

works.title: MELODIX•R
works.description: An XR design-fiction prototype on Quest 3 imagining a mixed-reality music experience placed in your real room.
works.idea_zh: 设计虚构：放在真实房间里的混合现实音乐体验。

works.title: Project North Star: Exploring Augmented Reality
works.description: Footage shot through the North Star AR headset showing bare-hand interactions: virtual objects, menus and effects you grab, pinch and swipe with tracked hands.
works.idea_zh: 用开源宽视场AR头显探索裸手操作全息内容的交互语言。

works.title: Project North Star: Desk UI
works.description: A North Star prototype that attaches holographic interfaces to a real desk, with virtual panels and widgets that you touch and manipulate as if they were physical desk objects.
works.idea_zh: 把全息界面贴附在真实书桌上，像实物一样触摸操作。

works.title: Just another day in the office at Magic Leap
works.description: Early Magic Leap concept footage made with Weta: a worker checks email on a holographic screen, then a robot invasion breaks out and he fights it with a ray gun around the real office.
works.idea_zh: 办公室里的日常突然被穿墙而来的机器人入侵打断。

works.title: Dr. Grordbort's Invaders
works.description: A Magic Leap One launch game in which portals open in your real walls and robots from Dr. Grordbort's universe pour into your living room while you fight back with a ray gun.
works.idea_zh: 墙面打开传送门，复古科幻机器人闯入你的客厅。

works.title: Grordbattle (multiplayer)
works.description: A co-located multiplayer Magic Leap duel from Weta Gameshop: players in the same real room see each other's avatars and trade ray-gun fire around the furniture.
works.idea_zh: 同一房间里多人戴Magic Leap用射线枪对战。

works.title: Fragments
works.description: A HoloLens crime thriller that maps your home and stages the investigation inside it: life-size characters sit on your real furniture and clues and memory reconstructions appear in your room.
works.idea_zh: 把真实家里变成犯罪调查现场，虚拟角色坐在你的沙发上。

works.title: Young Conker
works.description: A HoloLens platformer that scans your room and procedurally turns furniture and floors into levels for the squirrel Conker to run across.
works.idea_zh: 扫描房间，把家具和地面自动变成平台游戏关卡。

works.title: HoloForge Lab: HoloParticles tennis
works.description: A HoloForge Lab experiment with holographic particle effects on HoloLens 2, ending in a mock holographic tennis rally with hand-tracked swings.
works.idea_zh: 用全息粒子与手部追踪打一场全息网球。

works.title: Tónandi
works.description: An interactive Magic Leap soundscape in which glowing sound creatures spread across your real room; touching, gathering and waving at them with your hands layers and shapes Sigur Rós's music.
works.idea_zh: 伸手触碰房间里的发光生物来演奏和生成音乐。

works.title: Blackbox for Vision
works.description: Blackbox rebuilt for Apple Vision Pro: bubble-like puzzles float in your room and are solved by looking, reaching, speaking and moving through space instead of pressing buttons.
works.idea_zh: 没有按钮的谜题：用注视、手势、声音和身体移动去解开漂浮在房间里的谜。

works.title: Puzzling Places: Local Mixed Reality Multiplayer
works.description: Two people in the same room assemble a photogrammetry-scanned miniature landmark together over a real table in passthrough, passing pieces by hand.
works.idea_zh: 两个人在同一张真实桌子上合拼现实地标的微缩3D拼图。

works.title: Puzzling Places on Apple Vision Pro
works.description: The 3D jigsaw game redesigned for Vision Pro, with scanned places assembled in your room using eye-and-pinch input.
works.idea_zh: 在Vision Pro上用注视加捏合在房间里拼真实地点的立体拼图。

works.title: Angry Birds FPS: First Person Slingshot
works.description: Angry Birds rebuilt for Magic Leap One: pig fortresses are built on your real tables and floor, and you pull back a hand-held slingshot to knock them down.
works.idea_zh: 在真实桌面和地板上搭猪堡，亲手拉弹弓把它们打垮。

works.title: Demeo (Mixed Reality mode)
works.description: The tabletop dungeon crawler moved into passthrough: the game board sits on your real table and friends gather around it as avatars.
works.idea_zh: 把地下城桌游棋盘放到真实桌子上，朋友围坐一起玩。

works.title: Spatial Ops
works.description: A mixed-reality FPS in which players lay out cover and objectives across a real space and fight co-located or remote opponents through their homes and offices.
works.idea_zh: 把家或办公室变成多人同场的混合现实射击战场。

works.title: HoloKit
works.description: An open-source cardboard headset that turns an iPhone into a stereoscopic optical see-through AR wearable, with ARKit tracking and holograms shown in both eyes.
works.idea_zh: 用纸板和iPhone做一台开源的立体光学透视AR头显。

works.title: MOFA: The Duel
works.description: A co-located magic duel in which players wearing HoloKit headsets cast spells with hand gestures while spectators on phones watch and join; CHI 2023 best interactivity demo.
works.idea_zh: 戴HoloKit用手势施法对决，旁观者用手机加入观看的同场魔法对战。

works.title: MOFA: The Ghost
works.description: An asymmetric social exertion game in spontaneous co-located MR: an invisible ghost player hunts others who can only see it through their devices, played in public spaces.
works.idea_zh: 非对称捉鬼游戏：只有通过设备才能看见的'鬼'在公共空间里追逐玩家。

works.title: EchoVision
works.description: A handheld mixed-reality mask that lets people experience bat echolocation: your voice triggers LiDAR-based 'echoes' that briefly reveal the surrounding space as a visualized sound wave.
works.idea_zh: 用声音触发LiDAR回声可视化，像蝙蝠一样'听见'空间。

works.title: FeltSight
works.description: A mixed-reality haptic experience inspired by the tactile navigation of animals like the star-nosed mole: you feel your way through space via fingertip haptics instead of sight.
works.idea_zh: 模仿星鼻鼹鼠的触觉导航，用指尖触感而非视觉感知空间。

works.title: TouchPort / Allow me into your dream
works.description: A mixed-reality sharing protocol in which a handshake and pull signals intent, negotiates consent and opens a temporary shared layer between two people's separate mixed realities.
works.idea_zh: 握手一拉就把两个人各自的混合现实临时连接成共享空间。

works.title: Spatial Vacuuming
works.description: A Quest controller strapped to a vacuum paints the floor as you clean in passthrough, so you can see which parts of the room you have already covered.
works.idea_zh: 吸尘时在地板上实时标出已清洁区域，再也不漏掉角落。

works.title: Live Blender preview on Vision Pro
works.description: A Blender scene streams live into Apple Vision Pro; edits made on the desktop appear instantly as a full-size object lit by your real room.
works.idea_zh: 在Blender里改模型，Vision Pro里即时出现被真实环境照亮的实物大小预览。

works.title: Mixed Reality Test
works.description: A small demo mixing VR and AR: an ARKit iPhone and a VR headset share the same Normcore session so the phone sees the VR player's world placed in the real room.
works.idea_zh: 让iPhone AR与VR头显共享同一个多人空间。

works.title: iPhone AR in VR
works.description: A prototype that lets iOS users join and spectate a multiplayer VR space through ARKit, seeing the headset players' avatars in their own room.
works.idea_zh: 手机用户通过AR旁观并加入VR多人空间。

works.title: Augmented Reality Gestures
works.description: A prototype of multi-touch gestures for navigating 3D AR content on a touch screen, with 3D pan, pinch and zoom mapped to the scene.
works.idea_zh: 为手机AR设计的一套三维多点触控手势。

works.title: Lasertag
works.description: A mixed-reality laser tag game that scans your space and turns it into an arena for friends in the same room; beams stop at real walls and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 把任何空间变成同场多人激光枪战场，光束会被真实墙体遮挡。

works.title: Lasertag: synced room scanning
works.description: Demo of multiple Quest headsets building one shared depth reconstruction of a room in real time, so all players fight inside the same scanned geometry.
works.idea_zh: 多台头显实时同步扫描出同一个房间模型。

works.title: Lasertag: light VFX test
works.description: A test of laser shots that light up the real room: virtual beams cast light onto scanned walls and furniture in passthrough.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟激光照亮真实房间墙面的光效测试。

works.title: Fruit Defense
works.description: A single- and multiplayer Spectacles game in which real-world objects detected around you become active gameplay elements to defend.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜识别身边真实物体，把它们变成塔防游戏的一部分。

works.title: XR Worlds
works.description: A Spectacles proof of concept that turns a 2D drawing on paper into a playable XR world, using a generative world model.
works.idea_zh: 把纸上的二维涂鸦变成可玩的XR世界。

works.title: AI Teleport
works.description: A portal lens for Spectacles that uses Google Gemini to generatively restyle the user's surroundings in real time.
works.idea_zh: 用生成式AI实时把周围环境'传送'成另一种世界。

works.title: Ad Block
works.description: An experimental Spectacles app that works as a real-world ad blocker: Gemini detects billboards and ads in view and covers them.
works.idea_zh: 现实世界的广告拦截器：识别并遮挡眼前的广告牌。

works.title: Starship rocket in XR
works.description: A Spectacles experience that lets you launch a SpaceX Starship and guide the booster back to a 3D-printed launch tower on your table.
works.idea_zh: 发射星舰，再把助推器引导回桌上3D打印的发射塔。

works.title: LEGO AR glasses proof of concept
works.description: A Spectacles proof of concept that adds AR effects and characters to LEGO Smart Bricks builds, reacting to the physical bricks in play.
works.idea_zh: 给乐高智能积木叠加AR角色与特效，实体积木驱动虚拟内容。

works.title: Micro Art
works.description: An AR lens that reveals an imagined microscopic world inside plants, rocks and other things you point it at in nature.
works.idea_zh: 对准自然界的物体，揭示其中想象的微观世界。

works.title: Re-coaching a World Cup goal in AR
works.description: A real World Cup goal is rebuilt as a tabletop AR scene; you pause it, move a defender, and AI re-renders the alternate ending photorealistically.
works.idea_zh: 暂停真实世界杯进球，挪动防守球员，让AI重渲染另一种结局。

works.title: Meta Ray-Ban AI City Tour Guide
works.description: A proof of concept built at In The Pocket: a location-aware AI tour guide on Meta Ray-Ban glasses that walks you through Ghent and describes what you look at.
works.idea_zh: 戴Ray-Ban Meta眼镜的AI城市导游，边走边讲解眼前所见。

works.title: Bubbles
works.description: A Spectacles lens where you type a prompt, generate 3D models with Snap3D generative AI, and place several objects around you inside floating bubbles.
works.idea_zh: 输入文字即生成3D物体，装在泡泡里摆满你周围。

works.title: BPlane Adventures
works.description: A relaxing flow game for Spectacles: you steer a small plane with head movements and use your hands to boost it through the space around you.
works.idea_zh: 用头部转动驾驶小飞机，用手加速，在身边空间穿梭飞行。

works.title: Starship Home
works.description: A Quest 3 story game that converts your room into a starship: real walls get replaced by windows onto space, and you grow alien plants and pilot the ship with your hands.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的房间改造成星舰船舱，墙壁化为太空舷窗。

leads.name: Keiichi Matsuda
leads.why: Led Leap Motion's AR interaction design (North Star UI, Virtual Wearables); covered by the artists/speculative batch.

leads.name: Martin Schubert
leads.why: Leap Motion designer (Weightless, Mirrors embodiment experiment, Cat Explorer); mostly VR hand interaction, a few AR talks.

leads.name: Barrett Fox
leads.why: Leap Motion interaction engineer (Interaction Engine, Shortcuts/Scaffolding experiments); North Star interaction work.

leads.name: Takashi Yoshinaga
leads.why: Prolific AR prototyper combining Leap Motion hands with tabletop AR and Meta2 headsets.

leads.name: Noah Zerkin / CombineReality (North Star community)
leads.why: Built and sold North Star kits; community AR headset demos.

leads.name: Tim Stutts
leads.why: Former Magic Leap interaction designer (multimodal input, accessibility in AR); few public demo videos found.

leads.name: Alessio Grancini
leads.why: Magic Leap prototype engineer, now Snap Spectacles developer advocate; architecture-to-AR prototypes (Shilo XR).

leads.name: Jiabao Li
leads.why: Artist and co-creator of EchoVision (bat echolocation MR mask) with Botao Hu; likely belongs to artists batch.

leads.name: Danlin Huang
leads.why: Co-creator of FeltSight and EchoVision; haptic mixed-reality design research.

leads.name: Magic Leap Studios / ILMxLAB
leads.why: Lost Droids MR test (2015) and Magic Leap Create; corporate but historically important.

leads.name: Microsoft Studios (RoboRaid)
leads.why: HoloLens launch shooter where robots break through your real walls; corporate.

leads.name: Meta (First Encounters)
leads.why: Quest 3 bundled MR showcase where aliens break through your real walls; corporate.
